messages:
Alex W: hey all :wave: day 3 here — having trouble reaching internal postgres (10.12.4.22) from a docker container while on home VPN (split-tunnel).
Priya S: welcome! quick q — can you ssh to the bastion from your host?
Alex W: yes, `ssh alex@bastion.redwood.com` works. i can also `ssh -L 5432:10.12.4.22:5432 alex@bastion.redwood.com` but from the container `psql -h host.docker.internal -p 5432` times out.
Sam M: docker on mac uses its own VM/network (vpnkit). it won't pick up routes added by the VPN automatically.
Priya S: can you paste `route -n` (or `netstat -rn`) output from your host and `ip route` from inside the container?
Alex W: host netstat:
```
Routing tables
Internet:
Destination        Gateway        Flags
default            192.168.50.1   UGS
10.12.0.0/16       192.168.50.1   UG
```
container ip route:
```
default via 172.17.0.1 dev eth0
172.17.0.0/16 dev eth0 proto kernel scope link src 172.17.0.2
```
Sam M: yep — container default route goes to docker bridge (172.17.0.1) and doesn't know about 10.12.0.0/16. two quick fixes: run container with `--network=host` (not supported on mac), or add a route on the host and enable container to use host network via `host.docker.internal`, or run a tiny proxy on the host and publish ports.
Diego R: you can add a host route so host will forward traffic: `sudo route -n add -net 10.12.0.0/16 192.168.50.1` (replace with your VPN gateway). that makes host reach 10.12 and host.docker.internal should work.
IT Ops: note: if your VPN client sets `set-split-exclude` or uses per-app routing, docker vm might be excluded. If using WireGuard/Cloudflare Warp, enable 'Routes' to include 10.12.0.0/16.
Alex W: added the route, still timing out. i can curl localhost:5432 on host and see postgres banner, but container->host fails.
Priya S: try `docker run --rm --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway ...` or in compose set `extra_hosts: - \"host.docker.internal:host-gateway\"` then inside container `ping host.docker.internal` and `psql -h host.docker.internal -p 5432`.
Alex W: ok adding `--add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway` worked! container now connects to psql via the ssh tunnel. thanks :tada:
infra-bot: ticket INF-4721 created to track doc updates for mac + split-tunnel + docker networking (assigned to eng-infra).
Sam M: we'll add a short troubleshooting note to onboarding docs.
Alex W: appreciate all the help :heart:
